title: Ya, Todavía and Porque in Communication

sections.content: Combine ya and *todavía* no with *porque* to talk about recent communication. Say whether something has happened, whether it has happened yet, and why. Keep the *pretérito* *perfecto* for the recent action: Ya he *contestado* porque he *recibido* el *mensaje*.

items.spanish: Ya he contestado porque he recibido el mensaje.
items.english: I have already answered because I have received the message.

items.spanish: Todavía no he llamado porque estoy ocupado.
items.english: I have not called yet because I am busy.

items.spanish: Mi madre ya ha escrito porque tiene una noticia.
items.english: My mother has already written because she has news.

items.spanish: Mi padre todavía no ha llamado porque trabaja.
items.english: My father has not called yet because he is working.

sections.content: Use ya for completed recent actions, *todavía* no for actions that remain unfinished, and *porque* to explain the reason.
